options.name: administrators
options.description: List of queue administrators.

options.name: backfill
options.description: Backfill scheduling

options.name: chkPnt
options.description: Enables automatic checkpointing; value format: dir [period], where dir is the directory where the checkpoint files are created (do not use environment variables); period is the checkpoint period in minutes.

options.name: cloneFrom
options.description: The id or name of the entity that the new entity will be cloned from.  (take effect only at entity creation)

options.name: corelimit
options.description: The per-process core file size limit (in KB) for all of the processes belonging to a job from this queue.

options.name: cpulimit
options.description: Maximum normalized CPU time and optionally, the default normalized CPU time allowed for all processes of a job running in this queue; value format: [default_limit] maximum_limit.

options.name: datalimit
options.description: The per-process data segment size limit (in KB) for all of the processes belonging to a job from this queue.

options.name: defaultQueue
options.description: Specifies the queue which is to accept jobs when no queue is requested

options.name: default_host_spec
options.description: The default CPU time normalization host for the queue.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the queue that will be displayed by 'bqueues -l'

options.name: dispatch_window
options.description: The time windows in which jobs from this queue are dispatched.

options.name: epilog
options.description: Path to epilog script (post_exec).

options.name: exclusive
options.description: If Y, specifies an exclusive queue. Jobs submitted to an exclusive queue with 'bsub -x' will only be despatched to a host that has no other LSF jobs running.

options.name: fairshare
options.description: Fairshare scheduling

options.name: filelimit
options.description: The per-process file size limit (in KB) for all of the processes belonging to a job from this queue.

options.name: hjob_limit
options.description: Maximum number of job slots that this queue can use on any host.

options.name: hostEpilog
options.description: Path to per host epilog script (host_post_exec).

options.name: hostProlog
options.description: Path to per host prolog script (host_pre_exec).

options.name: hosts
options.description: A space-separated list of hosts, host groups, and host partitions on which jobs from this queue can be run.

options.name: ignore_deadline
options.description: If Y, disables deadline constraint scheduling (starts all jobs regardless of deadline constraints).

options.name: interactive
options.description: Causes the queue to reject interactive batch jobs (NO) or accept nothing but interactive batch jobs (ONLY). Interactive batch jobs are submitted via 'bsub -I'.

options.name: io
options.description: Built-in load index: disk I/O.

options.name: it
options.description: Built-in load index: idle time.

options.name: job_accept_interval
options.description: The number of dispatch turns to wait after dispatching a job to a host, before dispatching a second job to the same host.

options.name: job_controls
options.description: Changes the behaviour of the SUSPEND, RESUME, and TERMINATE actions.

options.name: job_starter
options.description: Creates a specific environment for submitted jobs prior to execution.

options.name: load_index
options.description: Scheduling and suspending thresholds for the specifed dynamic load index.

options.name: ls
options.description: Built-in load index.

options.name: mem
options.description: Built-in load index: available memory (in MB).

options.name: memlimit
options.description: The per-process memory resident set size limit (in KB) for all of the processes belonging to a job from this queue. Format is '[default_limit] maximum_limit'.

options.name: mig
options.description: Enables automatic job migration and specifies the migration threshold, in minutes.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of queue

options.name: new_job_sched_delay
options.description: The maximum or minimum length of time that a new job waits before being dispatched; the behavior depends on whether the delay period specified is longer or shorter than a regular dispatch interval (MBD_SLEEP_TIME in lsb.params, 60 seconds by default).

options.name: nice
options.description: Adjusts the Unix scheduling priority at which jobs from this queue execute.

options.name: options
options.description: Additional parameters that will be passed to the WLM queue configuration

options.name: pg
options.description: Built-in load index: pages in + pages out.

options.name: pjob_limit
options.description: The per-processor job slot limit for the queue.

options.name: pre_post_exec_user
options.description: Username for prolog and epilog execution.

options.name: preemption
options.description: Preemption scheduling

options.name: priority
options.description: Queue priority.

options.name: processlimit
options.description: Limits the number of concurrent processes that can be part of a job.

options.name: proclimit
options.description: Limits the number of processors that can be allocated to the job.

options.name: prolog
options.description: Path to prolog script (pre_exec).

options.name: qjob_limit
options.description: Job slot limit for the queue. Total number of job slots this queue can use.

options.name: r15m
options.description: Built-in load index: run queue length (15 min average).

options.name: r15s
options.description: Built-in load index: run queue length (15 sec average).

options.name: r1m
options.description: Built-in load index: run queue length (1 min average).

options.name: require_exit_values
options.description: The exit codes that will cause the job to be requeued.

options.name: rerunnable
options.description: If yes, enables automatic job rerun (restart).

options.name: res_req
options.description: Resource requirements used to determine eligible hosts.

options.name: resume_cond
options.description: Use the select section of the resource requirement string to specify load thresholds. All other sections are ignored.

options.name: run_window
options.description: Time period during which jobs in the queue are allowed to run.

options.name: runlimit
options.description: The maximum run limit and optionally the default run limit. Value format: [default_limit] maximum_limit.

options.name: slot_reserve
options.description: Enables processor reservation and specifies the number of dispatch turns over which a parallel job can reserve job slots.

options.name: stacklimit
options.description: The per-process stack segment size limit (in KB) for all of the processes belonging to a job from this queue.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the resource should have

options.name: stop_cond
options.description: Use the select section of the resource requirement string to specify load thresholds. All other sections are ignored.

options.name: swaplimit
options.description: The amount of total virtual memory limit (in KB) for a job from this queue.

options.name: swp
options.description: Built-in load index: available swap space (in MB).

options.name: terminate_when
options.description: Configures the queue to invoke the TERMINATE action instead of the SUSPEND action in the specified circumstance.

options.name: tmp
options.description: Built-in load index: available space in temporary file system (MB).

options.name: ujob_limit
options.description: The per-user job slot limit for the queue. Maximum number of slots that each user can use in this queue.

options.name: users
options.description: A list of users or user groups that can submit jobs to this queue. Use the reserved word all to specify all users.

options.name: ut
options.description: Built-in load index: CPU utilization.

options.name: wlmCluster
options.description: WlmCluster to which this node belongs
